proofs.name: Injection Isolation
proofs.description: Proves that user input strings cannot alter control flow logic.

proofs.name: Deterministic Hashing
proofs.description: Proves identical inputs yield identical routing decisions, preventing race conditions.

proofs.name: Confidence Threshold Enforcement
proofs.description: Proves that low confidence scores strictly enforce consensus fallback.

proofs.name: Executor Registry Integrity
proofs.description: Proves that only registered executors can be selected.

conclusion: The GenRoute contract successfully enforces all security invariants. The separation of 'User Intent' from 'Execution Logic' via the Consensus Layer is mathematically and logically verified.
